summary: decisions.md:599 now states the pin rule narrowed by provenance — third-party scanner and validator images pinned by digest (trivy, kubeconform named), first-party images we build on the estate's floating-tag norm — rewritten in place with no note left elsewhere. The root-rotation inventory landed at nine copies, not the six-to-seven the plan expected: gating the rewrite against the tree found two tracked, byte-identical, image-baked copies in DockerImages (arm64-cross, esp-idf) that the record never named and that predate this slice, so the phase recorded the true count rather than one its own gate had disproved. P7 is corrected in place to land nine in step-ca-root-rotation.md, and the pre-existing gap is close-out N1.
